## TL;DR

New schedule, New reminder, and New environment now use the same accent plus-icon button as New task, sitting on the right of their header row. The task-card agent panel fades closed after `board.agentPopoverCloseSeconds` (default 15; 0 leaves it open), and a hover, focus, or click inside restarts that timer. A running check with a fresh heartbeat is no longer reported as a stalled engineer in the driver brief or the decision digest, and the CTO restart action refuses that same case.

## Work and rationale

E1 followed Work and Context: `Button` with `variant="accent"` and `class="new-btn"`, plus the same plus-path SVG those pages already use. Scheduled tasks had the control inline beside the section label; it now sits in a `panel-create-row` so the label stays left and the button stays right. Reminders already used a space-between heading, so only the button variant, icon, and class changed. On Secrets the outline control left the environment picker row and moved into `page-header-actions`, to the right of the picker. `data-testid` values are unchanged (`new-schedule`, `new-reminder`). Secrets had no test id, so the header button is `new-environment`. Add key is still the accent button in the ledger. The empty-state "Create environment" control is also still accent, so Secrets can show two accent actions; Add key was left alone as specified.

E2 is the click-opened assignment panel (the robot), not the hover preview, which already dismisses on pointer leave. Opening it arms a timer from `config.data.board.agentPopoverCloseSeconds`. Pointer enter, move, focus, and click inside call the same arm function, so using the panel keeps it up. The leave transition is 0.28s opacity; the existing `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` rule still sets that transition to none. The key is a live number on the General settings section via `getConfigSchema()`, `SUPPORTED_TOML_KEYS`, the parser (0–3600, default 15), and `user-docs/configuration.md`.

E3 reuses `checkHeartbeating`. `agentSilenceCountsAsStalled` returns false when the runner's silence flag is set but a running check's `lastProgressAt` is inside the check stall window. `runningAgentIsStalled` applies that to the brief's running-agent rows and to the decision digest's silent-run list, using `taskChecks.getRuns`. The runner's own `snapshotStats` uses the same function through `setCheckProgressProbe`, so SSE and the attention feed do not keep the raw silence bit while a check is heartbeating. `isRestartCandidate` returns "check is still making progress" before it will relaunch, including when the runner entry is already gone but a check is still beating. `user-docs/check.md` now says the brief and the CTO digest follow that heartbeat.

## Approaches tried

Putting all three buttons into the Agents page header would have mixed them with the help links and hidden them on other tabs. The tab panel's own top row is the header the task asked for, and Secrets already has a page header, so the button belongs there.

Clearing `stalled` only inside `snapshotStats` would have fixed every consumer that reads `runner.stats`, but the brief test can pass runs without a live runner. Applying the predicate again in `assembleDriverBrief` and `assembleDecisionDigest` keeps those assemblers correct even when a caller supplies check runs beside a stats object that was computed earlier.

## Challenges and blockers

The agent popover people see on hover is a tooltip that already closes. The thing that stays up and covers neighbouring card content is the in-card panel the robot click toggles. The timer is on that panel.

CTO restart already refused while `runner.isRunning` was true, so a quiet engineer mid-check was not actually relaunched today. The new guard is the heartbeat predicate itself, so a check that is still progressing blocks restart even if the runner row is gone. Genuine silence with no check, or a heartbeat at or past the check stall window, still sets `stalled`.

## Key learnings

Other create controls that are not the three named buttons: the story panel's "New task" is already accent but small, with a text plus, inside the story drawer rather than a page header. "New task for me" on the needs-you empty state is still outline. "Create environment" on the Secrets empty state stays accent next to the new header button. None of those were restyled.

A check heartbeat and an agent silence timer are different clocks. The card already preferred the check clock. The brief was still reading the silence clock, which is why a `tail`ed `repoos check` looked stalled.

E4 was added on the board after the first handoff request. `.repo-dirty-input` set `min-height: 68px` with the same specificity as `.ff-textarea`, and the shared rule came later, so the commit box stayed about 230px. `.ff-textarea.repo-dirty-input` now follows the shared rule. The commit dialog's `.commit-modal-input` already sits later in the file and was left alone. Scoped `.ff-textarea` rules in the new-doc and new-skill panels do not set a smaller min-height.
